description: Failure A (empty-502) + Failure E (parallel spreading) — runtime verification, observability, and the one optional fan-out tweak. DIAGNOSIS: the empty-502 class as reported is NOT caused by memory-injection — all 33 stored 502 call logs have MEM=False; the real 502s are ECONNREFUSED (switcher/backend transition races, 41 in app.log) and 2x huggingface 'Provider returned empty content'; the bedrock claude-opus-5 failures are '400 on-demand throughput isn't supported', not empty-502. The exact 'empty response without usable output' string is in zero retained logs, so A is not reproducible from artifacts and is carried as needs-runtime-verification. Failure E (workers not spreading) is a downstream effect of A+C: when a tier 502s/500s, the 3-tier coder chain collapses onto the one capped GLM. Fixing C (FEAT-002) + reducing transition 502s + better observability is the primary E resolution; the only optional config win is raising stabulous-m5max GLM maxConcurrent 1->2 if it tests safe. Do NOT raise esnixi-5090 (OOMs at 2x) or gremlin IQ3 (ollama doesn't parallelize well).

findings: DONE. (1) Observability: reportMalformed200() in open-sse/utils/diagnostics.ts now emits mem=true|false|? (2) Runtime verification against https://omniroute.celestium.life with the inference key, authoritative evidence from GET /api/usage/call-logs (envelope model field is unreliable; account/provider/comboName/status are): (a) local/reader -> qwen3.5-reader:9b @ ollama-local/gremlin-4070ti-ollama (9B reader, NOT qwen3.8-27b) status=200; (b) local/code -> ds4-glm53 @ llama-cpp/stabulous-m5max (GLM, NEVER MLX) finish=stop; (c) two concurrent hybrid/code requests spread to TWO different members: ds4-glm53@stabulous-m5max + qwen3.8-27b-nvfp4@esnixi-5090, both 200 (Failure E resolved); (d) no 'System message must be at the beginning' 500 recurred; the only two 5xx in the window predate the probes and are a connect 'fetch failed' + a switcher 'terminated' (transition-race class), not System-first 500 and not empty-502. (6) No empty-output 502 recurred on vllm/bedrock during the probes, so the injection hypothesis is NOT re-opened (consistent with the diagnosis: all 33 retained empty-502 logs had MEM=False; real 502s are ECONNREFUSED/transition races). The deployed instance is 3.8.50; the diagnostics source edit reaches production only via an operator redeploy, so A observability is unit-verified here and will self-classify any future recurrence via the new mem= field.
